verdict.note: Accepted after independent mathematical adjudication. The n=8 prior is legal, its masses sum to 10^6, and direct recomputation from the response-type kernel gives exactly C_8. All 45 shifted-binomial risks for d_8 reproduce the serialized slacks, with maximum exactly I_8 only at (0,3) and (5,3), and exact arithmetic gives C_8>I_8 and C_8<U_8. The endpoint-subclass transfer has the correct lower-bound direction; Hull's Bernstein extension and separate convexity validly provide the full-cube upper bound. The n=2,4,6 comparisons are strictly valid, and n=8 follows from the rational certificates. No new assumption, assume-the-crux step, result-class degradation, kernel substitution, nonbinary two-count reduction, or claim of exact rho_8^CR was introduced. Hull's uniform conjecture and later-even/asymptotic claims remain open.
